name: Ramsey theory
summary: Ramsey proved a combinatorial theorem on homogeneous subsets while studying a decision problem in logic, and van der Waerden proved a related Ramsey-type theorem on arithmetic progressions.

name: Von Neumann algebras
summary: Weakly closed self-adjoint operator algebras on Hilbert space became a theory with Murray's classification of factors.

name: Tarski quantifier elimination
summary: Quantifier elimination showed the first-order theory of the reals is decidable.

name: Goedel incompleteness
summary: Coding of syntax by numbers was used to show that consistent arithmetical systems have unprovable true statements.

name: Ramsey theory and Hales-Jewett
summary: Ramsey's partition theorem is generalised to structured colourings.

name: Ergodic theory from statistical mechanics
summary: Koopman's operator on function spaces let von Neumann prove the first rigorous ergodic theorem.

name: Kolmogorov diffusion theory and PDE
summary: Continuous-time Markov processes were linked to parabolic equations, founding diffusion theory.

name: Hodge theory of harmonic integrals
summary: Harmonic forms represent cohomology on Kaehler manifolds.

name: Erdos discrepancy problem
summary: A combinatorial discrepancy question is reduced to correlations of multiplicative functions, then settled with entropy-decrement and short-interval results from analytic number theory.

name: Weil: integration on topological groups, harmonic analysis
summary: Haar measure and Pontryagin duality were systematised in a general setting.
